title: Online Job Applications Invited – Apply Now!
text:
📢 Job Applications Invited

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan is inviting applications for faculty positions. Please find details in the advertisements below:

Professors – Advertisement No. 60 (https://news.awkum.edu.pk/2025/09/applications-invited-for-post-of.html)

Associate Professors – Advertisement No. 61 (https://news.awkum.edu.pk/2025/09/applications-invited-for-posts-of.html)

Assistant Professors & Lecturers – Advertisement No. 62 (https://news.awkum.edu.pk/2025/09/applications-invited-for-posts-of_5.html)

📅 Apply before the deadline mentioned in each advertisement.
